full_judgment: 3. Plaintiffs predecessor purchased the suit land in 1929 and had been in possession on payment of Government revenue P.S. khatian stand in the names of plaintiff who made construction of a one-storied building on the land of R.S. plot No. 6889 which is situated in the Bazar area.
